原型ＵＳＥＲ。その略語。
　正規の訓練を経ずに高い作用力を発達させてしまった者。
　発達の方向性には個人差があり、ＵＳＥＲとして極めて高い数値が見られるこ
ともある。
　本人が現象行使者であることに無自覚なことが多い。
　あわせて同期性自我拡大症候群を患った原型ＵＳＥＲは、隠蔽・擬態・殺傷手
段などに特化する傾向があり、極めて危険。
lines.english: Short for “prototype USER.” A person who develops a high Effect rating without formal training. The direction of that development varies by individual, and some register values that are exceptional even by USER standards. Many remain unaware that they are wielders of phenomena. Prototype USERs who also suffer from Synchronous Ego Expansion Syndrome tend to specialize in methods of concealment, mimicry, or killing, and are extremely dangerous.

hyperlinks.preview: Among the expressions that came into vogue at the end of the twentieth century were “psychopath” and “macabre murder.” They generally referred either to people whose mental state differed from the norm or to crimes committed by such people—cases whose motives, methods, or sheer scale seemed largely inexplicable. Such murders were understood as isolated cases, and it was precisely their singularity that attracted so much attention.
